I added `discount_cents: int = 0` to `Invoice` in `src/billing/invoices.py`. It sits right after `tax_cents` and uses the same cents convention. Because it defaults to 0, existing callers still work. I didn't run any tests.

`finalize()` still posts `subtotal_cents + tax_cents` to the ledger, so the discount isn't applied to the amount yet. If you want it subtracted, the change is one line: `subtotal_cents - discount_cents + tax_cents`. I held off because that changes what gets posted to the ledger. `finalize()` also isn't idempotent, so be careful testing that path against a real ledger. `finalize_once()` guards against a repeat call.

I also didn't save anything to memory. Nothing durable came up beyond the `finalize()` hazard that's already recorded.
